name: Wilson Richards
text:
Reduce the resource cost of the first [[Tool]] asset you play each round by 1.
You get +1 skill value during skill tests on [[Tool]] assets.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may swap a [[Tool]] asset in your play area with a [[Tool]] asset in your hand with equal or lower printed cost.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: [[Tool]] cards level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other [[Improvised]] and/or [[Upgrade]] cards level 0-1. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Ad Hoc, Hasty Repairs, 1 random basic weakness.

name: Ad Hoc
text:
Wilson Richards deck only.
Attach Ad Hoc to a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset you control.
[reaction] After resolving an [action] ability on attached asset, exhaust Ad Hoc and discard a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset from your hand: Resolve an [action] ability on the discarded asset, ignoring all costs.
flavor: "This is one heckuva job."

name: Hasty Repairs
text: Revelation - Put Hasty Repairs into play in your threat area. While triggering abilities on assets you control, set your base skill value to 0. [action][action]: Discard Hasty Repairs.

name: Kate Winthrop
text: You begin the game with Flux Stabilizer (Inactive) side faceup. [fast]: Move 1 clue from Kate Winthrop to a [[Science]] or [[Tool]] asset you control with no clues on it. Forced - When an asset you control with a clue on it leaves play: Place its clue on your location. [elder_sign] effect: +0. You may move 1 clue from an asset you control back to Kate Winthrop.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, [[Science]] cards level 0-4, [[Insight]] cards level 0-1, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Flux Stabilizer, Failed Experiment, 1 random basic weakness.

name: Flux Stabilizer
text: Permanent. Kate Winthrop deck only. Forced - After a clue is placed on Flux Stabilizer: Search your bonded cards or discard pile for 1 copy of Aetheric Current and shuffle it into your deck. Flip Flux Stabilizer (keeping all tokens and attachments).

name: Flux Stabilizer
text:
Permanent. Kate Winthrop deck only.
[reaction] When you place a clue on an asset you control: Get +2 skill value for your next skill test this phase.
flavor: Is this the same energy harnessed by Nikola Tesla?

name: Aetheric Current
text: Bonded (Flux Stabilizer). Play only if Flux Stabilizer is on its (Active) side. Fight. Move all clues on assets you control to Kate Winthrop. For this attack, you may use [intellect] instead of [combat]. If you succeed and the attacked enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may exhaust it and move it to any location. Draw 1 card. Flip Flux Stabilizer (keeping all tokens and attachments).

name: Aetheric Current
text: Bonded (Flux Stabilizer). Play only if Flux Stabilizer is on its (Active) side. Evade. Move all clues on assets you control to Kate Winthrop. For this evasion attempt, you may use [intellect] instead of [agility]. If you succeed and the target of this evasion is non-[[Elite]], shuffle it into the encounter deck. Draw 1 card. Flip Flux Stabilizer (keeping all tokens and attachments).

name: Failed Experiment
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +1 difficulty for each asset you control with a clue on it. For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror or place 1 of your clues on your location.
flavor: "I've made a huge mistake."

name: Alessandra Zorzi
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to parley.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. If you succeed, choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location or at a revealed connecting location. Automatically evade that enemy.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, cards with "parley" level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of Beguile, Zamacona, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "I love a good party."

name: Beguile
text: Alessandra Zorzi deck only. Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach Beguile to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. [action]: Parley. Either move attached enemy to a revealed connecting location, or perform a basic investigate or evade action at its location. If you fail a skill test while resolving this ability, discard Beguile. You may activate this ability from any location.

name: Zamacona
text: Elusive. Spawn - Nearest empty location, if able. Alessandra Zorzi cannot parley with Zamacona. Forced - The first time Alessandra Zorzi parleys each round: Place 1 doom on Zamacona.

name: Kōhaku Narukami
text: [reaction] At the start of your turn: Either add 1 [bless] token or 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag, whichever there are fewer of (in case of a tie, you choose), or remove 2 [bless] tokens and 2 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag to take an additional action this turn. [elder_sign] effect: +2. Add 1 [bless] and 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: [[Blessed]] cards level 0-5, [[Cursed]] cards level 0-5, [[Occult]] cards level 0, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Book of Living Myths, Weeping Yurei, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "Why not greet the unknown with wonder rather than fear?"

name: Book of Living Myths
text: Kōhaku Narukami deck only. [reaction] When a chaos token would be revealed at your location, exhaust Book of Living Myths: Search the chaos bag for a [bless] or [curse] token, whichever there are more of (in case of a tie, you choose), and resolve it instead.

name: Weeping Yurei
text: Aloof. Elusive. Hunter. Prey - Kōhaku Narukami only. Forced - After an investigator reveals a [bless] token or [curse] token during a skill test at Weeping Yurei's location, if it is ready: Weeping Yurei attacks that investigator. (Limit once per test).

name: Hank Samson
text:
You may be assigned damage/horror dealt to [[Ally]] assets or other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When you would be defeated by damage and/or horror: Instead, heal all of your damage and horror and swap this card with its bonded [[Resolute]] version, either side faceup.
[elder_sign] effect: +1.
backText: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 other [[Innate]] and/or [[Spirit]] cards level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Stouthearted, "Where's Pa?", 1 random basic weakness.

name: Hank Samson
text:
Bonded (Hank Samson).
You cannot be healed. You may be assigned damage/horror dealt to [[Ally]] assets or other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When 1 or more horror is placed on you: Draw 1 card.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Move 1 horror from Hank Samson to an asset you control.

name: Hank Samson
text:
Bonded (Hank Samson).
You cannot be healed. You may be assigned damage/horror dealt to [[Ally]] assets or other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When 1 or more damage is placed on you: Gain 2 resources.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Move 1 damage from Hank Samson to an asset you control.

name: Stouthearted
text:
Hank Samson deck only.
Fast. Play when you engage a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Move up to 2 damage and/or horror from Hank Samson to that enemy, as damage.
flavor: Everyone is a hero to someone.

name: "Where's Pa?"
text: Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Attach "Where's Pa?" to that enemy and spawn it at a connecting location, if able. Attached enemy gains elusive. Forced - At the end of the round: Hank Samson takes 1 direct horror.

name: Ancestral Token
text: [reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Ancestral Token: Add [bless] tokens to the chaos bag equal to that enemy's printed health (max 5).
flavor: Never forget those who came before.

name: Cleaning Kit
text:
Uses (3 supplies).
Supplies on Cleaning Kit may be spent as if they were supplies or ammo on assets you control.
flavor:
"It cleans! It fixes! It picks, plucks, shines, and swishes!"
-Schoffner's Catalogue, Winter 1924 ed.

name: Katana
text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this test. If you succeed by exactly 2, you may exhaust Katana to deal +2 damage for this attack. [fast]Exhaust Katana: Fight. Use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack.

name: Ofuda
text:
Uses (1 charge). Replenish this charge the first time a [bless] token is revealed at your location each round.
[fast] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and spend 1 charge: That enemy loses the alert, aloof, elusive, and retaliate keywords until the end of the round.

name: Wolf Mask
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you engage an enemy.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [combat] or +2 [agility] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

name: Absolution
text:
Reveal 3 random tokens from the chaos bag, along with X additional tokens.
For each non-symbol token revealed, add 1 [bless] token to the chaos bag. For each [bless] token revealed, heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: Guided by Faith
text: Investigate. You may use [willpower] instead of [intellect] for this investigation. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, add 2 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag. If a [bless] or [elder_sign] token is revealed during this skill test, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: Hold Up
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and an [[Item]] asset in your hand. Perform a fight action against the chosen enemy. If you succeed, instead of dealing damage, play the chosen asset, reducing its cost by each point you succeeded by.
flavor: "H-hands where I can see 'em!"

name: Task Force
text:
As an additional cost to play Task Force, spend an action. One at a time, in any order, choose an investigator at your location to...
- ...resolve an [action] ability on an asset they control without paying its [action] cost.
- ...move to a connecting location.
- ...discover 1 clue at their location.

name: Tinker
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach Tinker to a [[Tool]] asset in your play area. Limit 1 per asset.
Attached asset takes up 1 fewer hand or accessory slot.
flavor: "You still call that a wrench?!"

name: Purified
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Purified to any type of test.
If this test is successful, for each point you succeeded by (to a maximum of 5), add 1 [bless] token or remove 1 [curse] token from the chaos bag.

name: Hand-Eye Coordination
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Resolve an [action] ability on a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset you control without paying its [action] cost.
flavor: Keep your eyes on the target.

name: Strong-Armed
text: While Strong-Armed is committed to an attack using a [[Melee]] or [[Ranged]] asset, this attack deals +1 damage. After revealing chaos token(s) for this skill test, you may take 1 damage to cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. (You may do this any number of times.)

name: Second Wind
text:
Play only as your first action.
Heal 2 damage (3 damage instead if you drew a treachery this round). Draw 1 card.

name: Cleaning Kit
text:
Uses (4 supplies).
Supplies on Cleaning Kit may be spent as if they were supplies or ammo on assets you control.
[reaction] When a supply is spent from Cleaning Kit, exhaust it: The performing investigator gets +2 skill value for this test.

name: Blessed Blade
text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, it deals +1 damage. Return each [bless] token revealed during this attack to the chaos bag. Before revealing chaos token(s) for this attack, you may exhaust Blessed Blade to add 2 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.

name: Eyes of Valusia
text: [action]: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Until the end of the round, each investigator gets +1 skill value while fighting, evading, or parleying with the chosen enemy. Place 1 resource on Eyes of Valusia, as a charge. [fast]: Search your bonded cards for Blade of Yoth and swap it with Eyes of Valusia, moving all charges from Eyes of Valusia to Blade of Yoth.

name: Blade of Yoth
text: Bonded (Eyes of Valusia). [action] Spend 1-3 charges: Fight. For this attack, you may use [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 skill value and deal +1 damage for each charge spent as part of this action's cost. [fast]: Search your bonded cards for Eyes of Valusia and swap it with Blade of Yoth, discarding all charges.

name: Flurry of Blows
text: Play only if you control a [[Melee]] asset. As an additional cost to play Flurry of Blows, spend an action. Fight. Choose a [[Melee]] asset you control and take an immediate fight action with that asset (without paying its [action] cost). You may repeat this effect up to three times. After the final attack resolves, if it is your turn, end your turn.

name: Miracle Wish
text:
Fast. Play after 1 or more [bless] tokens are revealed during a skill test at your location.
Search your bonded cards for Evanescent Ascension and put it into play. Place up to X resources on it, as wishes (to a maximum of the number of [bless] tokens revealed). Remove Miracle Wish from the game.

name: Evanescent Ascension
text: Bonded (Miracle Wish). If Evanescent Ascension has no wishes, set it aside, out of play. [reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, spend 1 wish and exhaust Evanescent Ascension: Resolve that investigator's [elder_sign] effect (in addition to all other tokens revealed during this test).

name: Chemistry Set
text: [action] Exhaust Chemistry Set: Investigate. If you... - ...fail by exactly 2, discard Chemistry Set. - ...succeed by exactly 0, gain 2 resources. - ...succeed by exactly 2, draw 1 card. - ...succeed by exactly 4, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: Dr. Charles West III
text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tool]] asset.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate by exactly 1 or 3, exhaust Dr. Charles West III: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: Microscope
text: [reaction] After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated, exhaust Microscope: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence. [action][action]: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +3 [intellect]). If you succeed, you may spend up to 2 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.

name: Mouse Mask
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you reveal a location or put a new location into play.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [willpower] or +2 [intellect] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

name: Ravenous Myconid
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
[action]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand.
[action] If Ravenous Myconid has 3 or more growth on it: Move each growth to your resource pool, as resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have classified a new species."

name: Uncanny Growth
text: Bonded (Ravenous Myconid). Investigate. After this test resolves, place 1 resource on Ravenous Myconid, as growth, for each point you succeed by. Set Uncanny Growth aside, out of play. If you fail, return Uncanny Growth to your hand.

name: Control Variable
text:
Fast. Play after an investigator reveals a [curse] token during a skill test at your location.
Discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: "There was a solution which he injected into the veins of dead things, and if they were fresh enough they responded in strange ways." -H.P. Lovecraft, Herbert West - Reanimator

name: Testing Sprint
text: As an additional cost to play Testing Sprint, spend an action. Investigate. One at a time, investigate your location and each connecting location once each in ascending order of shroud, until you either fail to investigate or successfully investigate each eligible location.

name: Thorough Inquiry
text: As an additional cost to play Thorough Inquiry, spend an action. Investigators at your location draw a combined total of 5 cards (you decide how many cards each investigator draws).
flavor: The truth is often hidden in plain sight.

name: "Throw the Book at Them!"
text: Fight. Choose a [[Tome]] asset you control. You get +X [combat] for this attack, where X is that asset's printed cost. If you succeed, you may either automatically evade the attacked enemy, or after the attack ends, you may resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on the chosen asset (ignoring its [action] cost, if any).
flavor: "Kid, you... you took that a lot more literally than I expected you to."

name: Transmogrify
text: Evade. You may use [intellect] instead of [agility] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Transmogrify to it. Attached enemy gains: "Massive. Cannot move. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Discover 1 clue at its location. (Limit once per round.)"
flavor: "I said 'blow it up,' not '<u>blow</u> it up!"

name: Well-Funded
text: While you control a [[Science]] or [[Tool]] asset, Well-Funded gains [wild] (while you control 3 or more [[Science]] and/or [[Tool]] assets, Well-Funded gains [wild] [wild], instead).
flavor: Every cent of that research grant counts.

name: Gabriel Carillo
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] At the start of your turn, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag: Draw 1 card.
flavor: "Helping you is easier than teaching my students geometry."

name: Steady-Handed
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test, exhaust Steady-Handed: You either succeed by 1 more or 1 less. If you succeeded by exactly 2, heal 1 horror.
flavor: A nick can be the difference between life and death.

name: Fine Tuning
text:
Attach to a [[Tool]] or [[Science]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[reaction] After attached asset exhausts, exhaust Fine Tuning: Ready attached asset.
flavor: "I assure you there's nothing to fear!"

name: Esoteric Method
text: After this skill test ends, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag for each point the performing investigator either succeeded or failed by.
flavor: Rumor has it the university's last phrenology professor enjoyed an unnaturally long tenure.

name: Prismatic Spectacles
text: [action] Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag: Investigate. You get +2 skill value for this investigation. If a [curse] token is revealed during this investigation, you may exhaust Prismatic Spectacles to discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: Confound
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's evade value. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location. Then, if the chosen enemy is non-[[Elite]], automatically evade it. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
flavor: "It'll never work, Herbert."

name: Microscope
text: [reaction] After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence. [action][action]: Investigate. You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +6 [intellect]). If you succeed, you may spend up to 3 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.

name: Ravenous Myconid
text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
[reaction] When an investigator draws a non-weakness treachery card, if their locations shroud is equal to or less than Ravenous Myconid's growth: Cancel that treachery's effects and discard it. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.

name: Ravenous Myconid
text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location with equal or fewer remaining health than the amount of growth on Ravenous Myconid: Defeat that enemy. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.

name: Ravenous Myconid
text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid: Either heal that much damage/horror from Ravenous Myconid, or move that much damage/horror from investigators or [[Ally]] assets at your location to Ravenous Myconid.

name: Bianca "Die Katz"
text: Limit 1 per deck. Uses (10 resources). [action] Exhaust Bianca "Die Katz": Parley. Move X resources from Bianca "Die Katz" to your resource pool. X cannot be more than 5. Test [agility] (X). If you fail, remember "you owe Bianca X resources." Then, search your bonded cards for the Bianca "Die Katz" enemy and spawn her at your location. Remove this card from the game.

name: Bianca "Die Katz"
text: Bonded (Bianca "Die Katz"). Hunter. Prey - Bearer only. [action] If "you owe Bianca X resources," spend X resources: Parley. Add Bianca "Die Katz" to the victory display. Forced - When Bianca "Die Katz" leaves play (except by the above ability): Shuffle her into your deck.

name: Blackmail File
text: [action] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's printed health value. If you succeed, that enemy disengages from each investigator and gains aloof until the end of the round.

name: British Bull Dog
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. [reaction] After you fail a skill test while parleying with an enemy: Put British Bull Dog into play from your hand.

name: Fake Credentials
text: [action] Choose an enemy at your location and exhaust Fake Credentials: Parley. Test [intellect] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each suspicion on Fake Credentials. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location and place 1 resource on Fake Credentials, as suspicion. If you fail, you must either discard Fake Credentials, or the chosen enemy attacks you.

name: Fox Mask
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you move out of a location with an enemy.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [intellect] or +2 [agility] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

name: Scrimshaw Charm
text: [action] Add 1-3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag and exhaust Scrimshaw Charm: Gain 1 resource. For each token added, gain 1 additional resource.
flavor: "Let faith oust fact; let fancy oust memory; I look deep down and do believe." - Herman Melville, <u>Moby-Dick</u>

name: Bank Job
text:
As an additional cost to play Bank Job, spend an action.
Investigators at your location gain a total of 8 resources, distributed as you wish.
flavor:
"No names, Skids."
"Sorry, Finn."

name: False Surrender
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and play a [[Weapon]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 1. You may then take a fight action with that weapon against the chosen enemy, using [agility] instead of the skill indicated.
flavor: "You'd have made a pretty good cowboy."

name: Grift
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [agility] (0). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 6). If you fail, that enemy attacks you.
flavor:
"Look! A dumb bird!"
"I don't see a bird."
"I do."

name: "I'll Pay You Back!"
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose another investigator at your location. Move all resources from that investigator's resource pool to your resource pool. At the end of the round, move all resources from your resource pool to that investigator's resource pool.

name: Stir the Pot
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [intellect] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's combined damage and horror values. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to each enemy at your location. If you succeed by 2 or more, after this effect resolves you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
flavor: "He <u>did</u> say something about your hair..."

name: Vamp
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test any skill (3). If you succeed and you tested... - ...[willpower], remove 1 doom from that enemy. - ...[intellect], discover 1 clue at your location. - ...[agility], automatically evade that enemy. If it is non-[[Elite]], move it to a connecting location. - ...[combat], deal 2 damage to that enemy.

name: Diabolical Luck
text: When you reveal a [curse] token during a skill test you are performing, you may commit Diabolical Luck to that skill test from your hand. If you do, Diabolical Luck gains [wild][wild][wild].
flavor: "Shoggoths. Why did it have to be shoggoths?"

name: Lightfooted
text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, you may automatically evade another enemy at your location.
flavor: "I never ran from anything like that devil tonight, though. Hope I never have to again." -Rita Young, Investigators of Arkham Horror

name: British Bull Dog
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack and you get +2 skill value. This attack deals +1 damage. Ignore the aloof keyword for this attack. [reaction] After you fail a skill test while parleying with an enemy: Put British Bull Dog into play from your hand.

name: Snitch
text:
Fast. Play after you succeed at a skill test while parleying.
Discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.
flavor: "I shouldn't be telling you this, but since you seem trustworthy..."

name: Bewitching
text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
[reaction] Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for up to 3 different [[Trick]] cards, and attach them facedown to Bewitching. Shuffle your deck.
[reaction] When you engage an enemy, exhaust Bewitching: Either draw 1 attached card, or search the top 9 cards of your deck for a copy of an attached card, draw it, and shuffle your deck.

name: Dirty Deeds
text: As an additional cost to play Dirty Deeds, spend an action. Search your deck for an [[Illicit]] asset and play it, paying its cost. Then, you may resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost, if any). Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Vamp
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and any number of skills. One at a time, in any order, test each chosen skill (2). For each test you succeeded, if it was... - ...[willpower], remove 1 doom from that enemy. - ...[intellect], discover 1 clue at that enemy's location. - ...[agility], automatically evade that enemy. Move it to a connecting location if it is non-[[Elite]]. - ...[combat], deal 2 damage to that enemy.

name: Fake Credentials
text: [action] Choose an enemy at your location: Parley. Test [intellect](0). This test gets +1 difficulty for each suspicion on Fake Credentials. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location or a connecting location. If you did not succeed by 2 or more, place 1 resource on Fake Credentials, as suspicion. If you fail, return Fake Credentials to your hand.

name: Stir the Pot
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [intellect] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's combined damage/horror values. If you succeed, deal X damage to each enemy at your location. After this effect resolves, you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
flavor: "...and I heard he called you stupid too!"

name: Cat Mask
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 2 of these offerings after doom is placed on a card with no doom.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [willpower] or +2 [combat] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

name: Rod of Carnamagos
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
[fast] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at any location and exhaust Rod of Carnamagos: Reveal 5 random chaos tokens from the chaos bag. If a [curse] token is revealed, search your bonded cards for a random [[Rot]] event and attach it to that enemy.

name: Abyssal Rot
text: Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos). Attached enemy cannot attack. Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Abyssal Rot aside, out of play.

name: Aember Rot
text: Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos). Forced - When attached enemy is defeated: Gain resources equal to its printed health (to a maximum of 5). Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Aember Rot aside, out of play.

name: Putrescent Rot
text: Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos). Attached enemy gets -1 fight and -1 evade. Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Putrescent Rot aside, out of play.

name: Scarlet Rot
text: Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos). Forced - At the end of the round: Attached enemy takes 1 damage. Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Scarlet Rot aside, out of play.

name: Virescent Rot
text: Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos). Attached enemy cannot move. Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Virescent Rot aside, out of play.

name: Speak to the Dead
text: Uses (6 offerings). [action] Spend any number of offerings: Parley. Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] event in your discard pile and reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of offerings spent. If at least 1 [skull] or [curse] token was revealed, return the chosen event to your hand.

name: Wicked Athame
text: [action] Add 1-3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack for each [curse] token added as part of this action's cost. If this attack defeats an enemy, replenish 1 charge or offering on an asset you control.

name: Antediluvian Hymn
text:
As an additional cost to play Antediluvian Hymn, spend an action.
Reveal the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. For each card revealed, you may add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag to place that card on the bottom of the encounter deck. Return the rest to the top of the encounter deck in any order.

name: Drain Essence
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [willpower] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's fight value. If you succeed, move 1 damage from your investigator to the chosen enemy (up to 2 damage instead if the chosen enemy is non-[[Elite]]).
flavor: What was yours is now mine.

name: Accursed
text: When you commit Accursed to a skill test, add up to 3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. During this skill test, treat the modifier of each [curse] token revealed as 0.
flavor: Not all who wander are lost.

name: Mesmeric Influence
text: While this card is committed to a skill test, the performing investigator may ignore all keyword or location effects that would trigger during this test.
flavor: The dreaming mind is as deep as any sea.

name: Olive McBride
text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 4 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.
flavor: You must invest yourself in every spell. Sometimes literally.

name: Rod of Carnamagos
text: [fast] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at any location and exhaust Rod of Carnamagos: Reveal 5 random chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each [curse] token revealed, you may search your bonded cards for a [[Rot]] event and attach it to that enemy.

name: Call the Beyond
text:
As an additional cost to play Call the Beyond, add 3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
Choose an asset you control with "uses (charges)" or "uses (secrets)". Replenish all of that asset's charges or secrets. Then, you may resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on that asset without paying its [action] cost, if any.

name: Ethereal Form
text: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, disengage from each other enemy engaged with you, and for the remainder of the round, you are ethereal (enemies cannot engage or be engaged with you, and you cannot attack or deal damage to enemies). If a symbol was revealed during this evasion attempt, return Ethereal Form to your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Read the Signs
text: Investigate. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this investigation. You may ignore any effect or keyword on your location which would trigger during this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a symbol was revealed during this investigation, return Read the Signs to your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Spectral Razor
text: Fight. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this attack. Immediately before this attack, you may engage the attacked enemy. This attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if the enemy is non-[[Elite]]). If a symbol was revealed during this attack, return Spectral Razor to your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Ethereal Weaving
text:
As an additional cost to play Ethereal Weaving, spend an action.
Reveal up to 3 different [[Spell]] events from your hand. One at a time, play each revealed event, reducing its cost by 1. While resolving each of these events, you get +2 skill value.

name: The Key of Solomon
text:
[fast] If there are more [bless] than [curse] tokens in the chaos bag, remove 1 [bless] token from the chaos bag and exhaust The Key of Solomon: Heal up to 2 damage and/or horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
[fast] If there are more [curse] than [bless] tokens in the chaos bag, remove 1 [curse] token from the chaos bag and exhaust The Key of Solomon: Gain 2 resources.

name: Seal of the Elders
text:
Fast. Play after a skill test at your location ends in which at least 2 [curse] tokens or 2 [bless] tokens were revealed.
If 2 [curse] tokens were revealed, search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Servant of Brass and put it into play. If 2 [bless] tokens were revealed, search your bonded cards for Keeper of the Key and put it into play. If 2 [curse] tokens and 2 [bless] tokens were revealed, do both instead. Remove Seal of the Elders from the game.

name: Keeper of the Key
text: Bonded (Seal of the Elders). [reaction] When a [bless] token is revealed during a skill test at your location: Deal 1 horror to Keeper of the Key and discover 1 clue at your location or a connecting location. Forced - When Keeper of the Key would leave play: Set it aside, out of play.

name: Servant of Brass
text: Bonded (Seal of the Elders). [reaction] When a [curse] token is revealed during a skill test at your location: Deal 1 damage to Servant of Brass and 2 damage to an enemy at your location or a connecting location. Forced - When Servant of Brass would leave play: Set it aside, out of play.

name: Matchbox
text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Matchbox has no supplies, discard it.
[fast] During any investigator's turn, exhaust Matchbox and spend 1 supply: Your location gets -1 shroud until the end of this turn.

name: Pelt Shipment
text:
While Pelt Shipment is in your hand, your maximum hand size is reduced by 3.
[reaction] When the game ends or you resign, if Pelt Shipment is in your hand: Reduce the experience cost of the next new card you purchase before the next scenario by 1.

name: Pitchfork
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If this attack is successful, lose control of Pitchfork and attach it to your location. Attached location gains: "[action]: Take control of Pitchfork. Any investigator at Pitchfork's location may trigger this ability."

name: Sparrow Mask
text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you take 1 or more damage and/or horror.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [willpower] or +2 [agility] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

name: Elaborate Distraction
text: As an additional cost to play Elaborate Distraction, spend an action. Playing Elaborate Distraction does not provoke attacks of opportunity. For each enemy at your location and at each connecting location (choose one): - Automatically evade that enemy if it is non-[[Elite]]. - Deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Pushed to the Limit
text: Choose a [[Weapon]] or [[Tool]] asset in your discard pile. Resolve an [action] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost). After this effect resolves, shuffle the chosen asset into your deck. Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Stall for Time
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test [willpower] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's fight or evade value, whichever is lower. If you succeed, exhaust the chosen enemy (but do not disengage from it). If it is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase. If you fail, return Stall for Time to your hand.

name: Wrong Place, Right Time
text:
As an additional cost to play Wrong Place, Right Time, spend an action.
Move up to 5 damage and/or horror from your investigator to assets controlled by investigators at your location. For each asset defeated by this effect, draw 1 card. Remove Wrong Place, Right Time from the game.

name: Long Shot
text:
You may commit Long Shot to a fight or evasion test against an enemy at your location or a connecting location.
If this test is successful, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Hatchet
text: [action]: Fight. Add your [agility] to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, discard Hatchet. Otherwise, lose control of Hatchet and attach it to the attacked enemy. Attached enemy gains: "[reaction] When attached enemy is defeated: Take control of Hatchet. Any investigator at Hatchet's location may trigger this ability."

name: Persistence
text: You may commit Persistence to a skill test from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after this test ends.
flavor: "Anyone but a stolid farmer would have fainted or gone mad..." - H.P. Lovecraft, <u>The Colour Out of Space</u>

name: "Devil"
text: Forced - When your turn begins: Move 1 damage from your investigator to "Devil". Forced - When "Devil" is defeated: Deal 2 damage to each enemy and investigator at your location.
flavor: I will guide thy hand.

name: Fire Axe
text: Fast. [action]: Fight. If you have no resources in your resource pool, this attack deals +1 damage. [fast] During an attack using Fire Axe, spend 1 resource: You get +2 [combat] for this skill test. (Limit three times per attack.)

name: Hunting Jacket
text:
[fast] Exhaust Hunting Jacket: Choose 1 non-weakness card in your hand and attach it facedown to Hunting Jacket (max 3 cards attached). Then, gain 1 resource for each attached card.
[reaction] When Hunting Jacket is defeated: Draw each attached card.

name: Mariner's Compass
text: [action] Exhaust Mariner's Compass: Investigate. If you fail, ready Mariner's Compass. If you succeed and have no resources in your resource pool, discover 1 additional clue at your location. [fast] During an investigation using Mariner's Compass, spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test. (Limit three times per investigation.)

name: Survival Technique
text:
[fast] Choose a card you own that is attached to your location and exhaust Survival Technique: Add that card to your hand.
[fast] During a skill test on a location or on a treachery attached to your location, exhaust Survival Technique: You get +2 skill value for this test.

name: Keep Faith
text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Add 4 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.
flavor: Those who walk in faith need not fear the dark.

name: Providential
text: If this skill test is successful, add 1 [bless] token to the chaos bag for each damage or horror on you (whichever is less).
flavor: Courage is your best defense against whatever horrors lurk beyond.

name: Token of Faith
text: [reaction] After a skill test ends in which 1 or more [curse] or [auto_fail] tokens were revealed, exhaust Token of Faith: Add that many [bless] tokens to the chaos bag. If this skill test failed, after resolving all effects from the failed test, the performing investigator may attempt that test again. (Max once per test.)

name: Dark Horse
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
During the upkeep phase, you may choose to not gain resources.
While you have no resources in your resource pool, you get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].

name: Eldritch Tongue
text:
Uses (4 charges).
You may play events with "parley" from your discard pile as if they were in your hand. As an additional cost to play an event this way, spend 1 charge from Eldritch Tongue. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.

name: Bide Your Time
text:
As an additional cost to play Bide Your Time, spend an action.
During your next turn, you may take two additional actions.
flavor: It's half past midnight, and you're starting to wonder if the whole thing's a ruse.

name: Well-Dressed
text: While Well-Dressed is committed to a skill test during a parley action, it gains [wild] [wild] [wild].
flavor: The fine clothes do all the talking.

name: Dawn Star
text:
Fast. Play after revealing chaos tokens during a skill test at your location.
Ignore the modifiers of each [curse] token revealed during this test. For each [curse] token ignored, deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: Only the strongest spirit can sunder the dark.

name: Occult Reliquary
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
You have 1 additional hand, accessory, or arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Blessed]] or [[Cursed]] asset.
flavor: "The price is but a pittance for what you will gain."

name: Broken Diadem
text:
Limit 1 per deck. Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
[reaction] After a skill test at your location ends in which both a [bless] and [curse] token were revealed: Place 1 resource on this card, as an offering. Then, if there are 3 offerings on this card, search your bonded cards for Twilight Diadem and swap it with this card, moving all offerings from this card to Twilight Diadem.

name: Twilight Diadem
text:
Bonded (Broken Diadem). Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
[reaction] When you reveal either a [bless] or [curse] token during a skill test, spend 1 offering and exhaust this card: Treat the revealed token as an [elder_sign] token instead, returning it to the chaos bag. Then, if this card has no offerings, search your bonded cards for Broken Diadem and swap it with this card.

name: Maimed Hand
text: Revelation - You must either put Maimed Hand into play in your threat area, or take 1 damage and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the [action][action] ability below. You get -1 health. [action][action]: Discard Maimed Hand.

name: Back Injury
text: Revelation - You must either put Back Injury into play in your threat area, or take 1 damage and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the [action][action] ability below. You get -1 health. [action][action]: Discard Back Injury.

name: The Silver Moth
text: Revelation - You must either put The Silver Moth into play in your threat area, or take 1 horror and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the [action][action] ability below. You get -1 sanity. [action][action]: Discard The Silver Moth.

name: Vow of Drzytelech
text: Revelation - You must either put Vow of Drzytelech into play in your threat area, or take 1 horror and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the [action][action] ability below. You get -1 sanity. [action][action]: Discard Vow of Drzytelech.

name: Written in Rock
text:
Easy / Standard - Act 1
[skull]: -X. X is your location's column number.
[cultist]: -1. Place 1 resource on this card, as a scrap.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, remove 1 scrap from this card.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, take 1 damage.
backText:
Easy / Standard - Act 2
[skull]: -X. X is your location's column number.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 resource on this card, as a switch.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, move the Mine Cart once.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, remove 1 switch from this card.

name: Written in Rock
text:
Hard / Expert - Act 1
[skull]: -X. X is twice your location's column number.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, place 1 resource on this card, as a scrap.
[tablet]: -4. Remove 1 scrap from this card.
[elder_thing]: -5. Take 1 damage.
backText:
Hard / Expert - Act 2
[skull]: -X. X is twice your location's column number.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, place 1 resource on this card, as a switch.
[tablet]: -4. Move the Mine Cart once.
[elder_thing]: -5. Remove 1 switch from this card.

name: Underground Survey
text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda. [action] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Move 1 resource from your location to the scenario reference card, as a scrap. If the enconter card just drawn was a [[Power]] treachery, gain 5 resources.
backText:
Deal 2 damage to each investigator and 1 direct damage to each [[Ally] asset they control.
Reveal the Control Station location and move each surviving investigator to it.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Advance the act.
flavor: The old mine is full of dilapidated machinery and an old rail track. What secrets are written in rock below?

name: Dangerous Ride
text:
Locations with a story asset on them cannot be slid or swapped.
Each enemy gains the hunter keyword and resolves its hunter keyword an additional time during the enemy phase.
When an enemy moves, each adjacent location is considered to be connected to its location.
backText: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical or 1 mental trauma.
flavor: You now know why North Point Mine was abandoned. Writhing abominations and frenzied miners prowl the tunnels, hungry for their next meal.

name: Descent into the Mines
text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at Control Station, advance. (Hint: Get to the Control Station before the agenda advances!)
backText: Remove each [[Cave]] location from the game (discarding all enemies, tokens, and attachments at those locations). If River Hawthorne is in play but not under control of any investigator, remove them from the game. Each investigator loses all but 2 of their clues. If it is agenda 1a, advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b). Your search for supplies will help you navigate whatever is ahead. Flip the scenario reference card over to its other side, moving all scraps on it to that side, as switches. Read Scenario interlude: The Cave-In (page 10).
flavor: You realize the eerie hum in the air comes from vibrating crystal formations. Something feels strange, though you cannot say what...

name: The Underground Maze
text: [fast] During your turn, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Either slide a location into an empty adjacent space, or swap 2 adjacent locations. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Slide a revealed location into an empty adjacent space. (Group limit once per round.) [action] If the Prismatic Shard story asset is at your location: Take control of it. Objective - Get to the Rail Exit! When the Mine Card enters Rail Exit, immediately advance.
backText: Check the following: - If an investigator controls Simeon Atwood, (→R1). - If an investigator controls Leah Atwood, (→R2). - If Simeon Atwood is set aside or still in play and not under the control of an investigator, (→R3). - If Leah Atwood is set aside or still in play and not under the control of an investigator, (→R4). - If none of the above is true, (→R5).
flavor: The only way out of North Point Mine is through the maze of rail tunnels.

name: Mine Cart
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move Mine Cart once. If it moves off the rail line, each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. [reaction] When Mine Cart moves, spend 1 switch: Either cancel the move, or move an additional time. (Group limit twice per phase.)

name: Control Station
text: [fast] During your turn: Swap 2 adjacent [[Rail]] locations. (Group limit once per game.)
backText: As an additional cost to enter Control Station, investigators at an adjacent location must spend 2[per_investigator] clues, as a group.
flavor: The back of the station is filled with crates of very old dynamite and stocks of gunpowder.

name: Rail Exit
text: Rail Exit cannot be slid or swapped.
backText: Rail Exit cannot be slid or swapped.
flavor: Scratch marks score the walls and beams nearby. You shudder to think of the frenzied creatures who have excaped North Point Mine to hunt for their next meal.

name: Left Turn
text: [action][action]: Swap 2 adjacent [[Rail]] locations. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The crystals emanate a strange light.

name: Left Turn
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Slide a location into an empty space adjacent to it. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: The crystals emanate a strange light.

name: Right Turn
text: [action][action]: Swap 2 adjacent [[Rail]] locations. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: A strange light emanates from the crystals.

name: Right Turn
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Slide a location into an empty space adjacent to it. (Group limit once per game.)
flavor: A strange light emanates from the crystals.

name: Alkaline Rail
text: Forced - At the end of the round: Deal 1 horror to each investigator and [[Resident]] asset at Alkaline Rail.
flavor: The tunnel is choked with a blood-red mist. Every breath induces a painful fit of coughing.

name: Warped Rail
text: Forced - After the Mine Cart enters Warped Rail: Move the Mine Cart once.
flavor: Looking down the spiraling tunnel makes your head swim.

name: Sunken Rail
text: Forced - After Sunken Rail is revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. The lead investigator draws that enemy.
flavor: What really lurks underwater?

name: Forked Rail
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if the Mine Cart is at Forked Rail: Discard 1 switch from the scenario reference card.
flavor: The air smells less foul down two passages. But should you really follow your nose?

name: Rail Bridge
text:
X is Rail Bridge's column number.
[action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as a switch. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: The minerals in the rock glimmer like stars.

name: Subterranean Beast
text:
Hunter. Massive.
Subterranean Beast gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
If Subterranean Beast is ready and at the Mine Cart's location, the Mine Cart cannot move.
[action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Exhaust Subterranean Beast. It cannot ready this round.

name: Burrowing Hybrid
text: Hunter. Forced - After Burrowning Hybrid enters play, if the Mine Cart is facing a connecting location: Slide that location into an adjacent empty space. If you cannot, swap it with a location adjacent to it.
flavor: It definitely doesn't just eat worms.

name: Frenzied Miner
text: Hunter. X is Frenzied Miner's column number. Forced - After Frenzied Miner attacks you: Deal 1 damage to each other investigator and [[Resident]] asset at this location.

name: Cave-In
text: Revelation - Attach Cave-In to the location the Mine Cart is facing. If you cannot, Cave-In gains surge. Forced - When the Mine Cart would move into attached location: Cancel the move and deal 2 damage to each investigator and [[Resident]] asset in the Mine Cart. [action]: Test [combat] or [agility] (2). If you succeed, discard Cave-In. An investigator at an adjacent location may trigger this ability.

name: Wild Ride
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (5). If you fail, put Wild Ride into play in your threat area. Forced - When the Mine Cart moves: Either move it 2 additional times, or deal 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror to each investigator, [[Ally]] asset, and [[Resident]] card they control. Discard Wild Ride.

name: Prismatic Shard
text:
Uses (4 brilliance).
[reaction] When a scenario card or weakness card effect would discard any number of cards from your hand, exhaust Prismatic Shard and spend 1 brilliance: Ignore that effect and draw that many cards, instead.

name: Hemlock House
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is your current floor number (to a minimum of 1).
[cultist]: -1. If your location is an enemy, exhaust it.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, heal 1 damage from the nearest enemy-location.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, and it is agenda 2a or 3a, after this test resolves, remove this token from the chaos bag and add it to the predation bag.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is twice your current floor number (to a minimum of 2).
[cultist]: -2. If you succeed and your location is an enemy, exhaust it.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, heal 1 [per_investigator] damage from the nearest enemy-location.
[elder_thing]: -5. If it is agenda 2a or 3a, after this test resolves, remove this token from the chaos bag and add it to the predation bag.

name: The Predatory House
text: Create a separate bag consisting of the following tokens: [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing]. (If you do not have a second bag, you can use a cup, bowl, or other opaque container.) This is the predation bag, and these are predation tokens. They are not chaos tokens. Then, add the following tokens to the predation bag based on the current day: - Day 1: Add [cultist], [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 2: Add [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 3: No change is made. Some abilities will instruct investigators to make a predation test. A predation test may cause the house to come alive and prey on the investigators. To resolve a predation test, reveal a random token from the predation bag and resolve the effects for that token as indicated on the other side of this card. Flip this card over and place it next to the scenario reference card.

name: Predation Test
text: Use these results only when revealing tokens from the predation bag. [cultist]: Set this token aside. [tablet]: Each enemy-location attacks each investigator at that location. If no attack was made by this effect, the lead investigator draws the top card of the encounter deck. Return this token and each set-aside token to the predation bag. [elder_thing]: Set this token aside. Find the unsealed, [[Dormant]] location nearest to the lead investigator. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.

name: Eerie Silence
backText:
Shuffle each copy of the set-aside Out of the Walls and Pulled In treacheries into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Find the set-aside The Predatory House story card and resolve its text.
flavor: Your first steps into the old manor come with a fetid odor and an intense feeling of being watched. The air is too still, and for an abandoned house, there is an unsettling lack of dust on the furniture and floors. If nobody has lived here for years, then why does it feel like everything has moved recently?

name: The House Stirs (v. I)
text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
backText: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
flavor: It is no mere infestation of rats or woodland creatures that haunts this decrepit manor. Something vile lives in Hemlock House. It burrows through the floor, writhes within its walls, and watches you with invisible, hungry eyes.

name: The House Stirs (v.II)
text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
backText:
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Attach a set-aside Fire! treachery to the leftmost location on the highest floor. Shuffle each other copy of Fire! into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
flavor: It is no mere infestation of rats or woodland creatures that haunts this decrepit manor. Something vile lives in Hemlock House. It burrows through the floor, writhes within its walls, and watches you with invisible, hungry eyes.

name: Living Walls
text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
backText: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
flavor: Either the house is alive, or the creature within its walls has grown to encompass it entirely. Your only hope now is to either secure all of the rooms, turn this place into rubble, or flee and make sure nobody ever ventures near this place ever again.

name: Strange Infestation
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. [action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. Objective - At the end of the round, if a total of 7 locations are sealed and/or in the victory display, advance.
backText:
If there are more seals in play than enemy-locations in the victory display:
Your efforts to suppress the strange infestation seem to have angered it. A noisome screech shakes the foundation of the house, and the air floods with a fetid stench of something awful down below.
Put the set-aside Shapeless Cellar enemy-location into play on the Cellar Floor, as close to the middle column as possible. Advance to the set-aside act 2a "The Heart of the House" and remove act 2a "Against the House" from the game.
If there are more enemy-locations in the victory display than seals in play:
The foundations of the house shake as another room threatens to collapse. If you bring this house down, the abomination that lives inside it won't survive long.
Advance to the set-aside act 2a "Against the House" and remove act 2a "The Heart of the House" from the game.

name: Against the House
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. Objective - Bring this house down! If no locations are in play, immediately advance (this occurs before investigators would be defeated by not being at a location).
backName: Fall of the House of Hemlock
flavor: Sealing this creature away won't solve anything. Whatever sort of monster has taken over Hemlock House, it needs to be destroyed.

name: The Heart of the House
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. text: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions. Forced - When you end your turn at this location, if you did not successfully fight this round: You must either place 1 of your clues on this location, or discard 1 card at random from your hand.
backText: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions.

text: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions. Forced - When you end your turn at this location, if you did not successfully evade this round: You must either place 1 of your clues on this location, or discard 1 card at random from your hand.
backText: Mirror Nest is connected to the location in the clockwise and counter-clockwise directions.
